runbooks.title: Air-handler anomaly review (fictional)
checks: Compare the two recorded synthetic indicators against the shift journal.
Identify whether a maintenance history entry is missing or stale.
Ask a qualified human reviewer to decide what observations are needed.

runbooks.title: Access-system handoff review (fictional)
checks: Compare event journal timestamps for the fictional access log.
Identify whether the latest badge-system status is independently observed.
Request human security-team review before any operational change.

runbooks.title: Network-monitoring incident handoff (fictional)
checks: Compare two fictional heartbeat records and confirm the logging window.
Check whether the last verified operator note is available.
Have a human owner decide whether further read-only diagnostics are needed.

scenarios.title: When the status light shifts
scenarios.mission: Give the next fictional building shift a sourced and cautious anomaly handoff.

signals.observation: Demo air-handler fan indicated an intermittent yellow status LED.
Synthetic temperature indicator changed from 23 C to 27 C over 25 minutes.
No maintenance record is available in this synthetic example.

scenarios.title: An incomplete access record
scenarios.mission: Carry ambiguous synthetic access-log evidence into a human-owned handoff without granting entry.

signals.observation: Fictional access log contains one incomplete timestamp.
Demo door indicator was reported amber during a shift change.
The current access-system status has not been independently recorded.

scenarios.title: Two heartbeat signals disagree
scenarios.mission: Produce a bounded read-only handoff from fictional operations evidence, not a network command.

signals.observation: Synthetic network heartbeat shows one missing interval.
A separate fictional monitor reports the link as reachable.
The last operator verification record is unavailable.
